quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Confectionery leader with ~45% US chocolate share. Peak EPS override is kept null to preserve consistency with cycle multiples (mult_low_5y 45.63x, mult_high_5y 60.52x) derived from reported peak series; on normalized pre-cocoa-shock owner earnings of ~$9.50, the equivalent PAR multiple is ~13.0x, yielding identical PAR value ($123.14). 5-10Y through-the-cycle growth g_implied of 5.0% reflects 1.0% snack volume + 2.0% brand pricing + 1.0% product mix - 0.5% input cost drag + 1.5% share repurchases. Solid balance sheet with net debt/EBITDA ~2.0x and 6.4x interest coverage, but current price ($173.48) trades Above PAR (+40.9% premium), offering 1.2% 5Y expected IRR.
